text:
tara: quick follow-up on the safety-net idea for quant profiles. thinking about deterministic fallthrough trees + lightweight metrics to trigger per-request fallbacks.

oscar: love it. what's the minimal runtime contract?

tara: runtime receives ordered list: [preferred_profile, fallback_profile, final_profile]. each level has min_samples and degrade_threshold. if live_loss > threshold -> step to fallback.

jin: need seed determinism so replays pick same branch. also prefer non-blocking checks (async eval) to avoid added latency.

ops_maya: ops concern: when we flip profile mid-session we invalidate KV cache; that's expensive. idea: allow "graceful downgrade" where we keep cache but mark responses as "fallback" via header `x-precision-fallback`. then clients can choose to revalidate.

sam_t: telemetry: include fields profile_id, branch_reason, degrade_metric (e.g., token_error_count). store 1% full traces for offline debugging.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary safety-net v1 -> 1% traffic at 2024-05-03T14:00:00Z

oscar: edgecase: mixed batches where some requests are on fallback and some not. runtime must enforce homogeneous bitwidth within a batch or split into two batches.

tara: yes, runtime will partition batches by bitwidth and sequence length. cost: additional scheduling overhead but keeps kernel correctness.

jin: API surface: expose a read-only `effective_profile` in response metadata so customers can see what profile served the request. not opt-in.

ops_maya: add alert: cohort fallback rate > 2% sustained -> pause rollout for that cohort. Also log any 5xx correlated with fallback transitions.

oscar: one more: schema for fallback trees. propose compact JSON schema snippet:
```
{ "profile_id": "anchored-v1", "fallbacks": [ {"id":"int8-safe", "min_samples":50, "degrade_threshold":0.03}, {"id":"global-fp8","min_samples":10, "degrade_threshold":0.1} ] }
```

sam_t: implementable. I'll add a small shim to annotate traces and wire the `effective_profile` header.

tara: action items:
- sam_t: header + telemetry (ETA EOD)
- jin: deterministic replay harness for branch logic (ETA 48h)
- ops_maya: alerts + playbook for cohort pause (ETA tomorrow)
- oscar: perf estimate for batch partitioning (ETA 48h)

ops_maya: +1. also add runbook step: if fallback spikes, temporarily pin cohort to its previous stable profile and capture traces.

tera: thanks all. will draft brief RFC describing safety-net tree and append to the precision-profile RFC set. reopen after canary metrics.
